proposed_widenings.name: replace_weapon_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive rider replaces this weapon's normal piercing damage with lightning damage on a qualifying hit. The current surface can add damage or modify damage numbers, but it cannot substitute one existing weapon damage type for another.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The activated throw effect deterministically relocates the weapon back to the wielder's hand after the line-save damage resolves. The current surface has no honest item-motion or return-to-hand atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: Top-level fit exists as a composite magic item with a passive rider plus a replace-attack, once-per-dawn activation. I did not author a Dhall/JSON content file because those two mechanics cannot be represented honestly with the current atoms.
